# Siddharth Bagga

> Diligence and valuation analyst for private capital, seeking a seat with a family office, private wealth team or lower-middle-market private equity firm. M.S. Financial Mathematics, University of Cincinnati. Based in Cincinnati, relocating to New York. Open to commercial due diligence, valuation, corporate strategy and investment analysis roles.

## Experience
- Strategic Finance Lead, Turnkey Services Pro (Jan–Jun 2026): underwrote a $6M+ multi-state acquisition pipeline (normalized EBITDA, IRR/MOIC, purchase-price sensitivity); wrote go/no-go investment memos; opex down 6%.
- Financial Associate, Turnkey Services Pro (Aug 2025–Jan 2026): built the finance function from raw bank statements; decision-making efficiency +75% in month one.
- Wealth Management Intern, Cerity Partners (Jan–Mar 2025): reporting turnaround −30%.

## Education and credentials
- M.S. Financial Mathematics; Graduate Certificate, Quantitative Finance — University of Cincinnati
- B.Com (Honors) Finance — University of Delhi
- Bloomberg Market Concepts. CFA Level I: exam-fee scholarship awarded 2025; exam not yet taken.

## Research
- Strategy Lab: interactive backtests of six allocation and risk rules on weekly ETF data, 2015–2026. Hypothetical research, not investment advice.
- Online portfolio selection study: PAMR and OLMAR look strong without costs but their edge disappears at about 5 bps per side; Monte Carlo (1,000 block-bootstrap paths) shows defensive rules mainly reduce drawdowns rather than beat SPY's return.
- Deal Lab: wholesale real-estate underwriting with buyer costs, rehab contingency and a Monte Carlo of ARV and rehab risk; Excel model downloadable.
- Twin-Engine: concept dashboard for a US BRRRR + India flip platform, on illustrative sample data.
- High Properties: full-stack lead-generation platform (public code on GitHub).
